_comfy_bridge.name: Depth - Depth Anything 3
_comfy_bridge.description: Depth Anything 3 (ComfyUI core nodes, local and Comfy Cloud). Relative depth, near = white, ready for the aux of Render to photo or ZDefocus (math 'far = 0'). Sharp edges; flat surfaces can wobble a little (for single frames MoGe 2 is usually better). Sky clip pushes the sky to far. Use the Apache 2.0 models (mono large, base, small) for paid work.

params.label: model
params.tooltip: mono large: best relative depth. base / small: lighter. All four are Apache 2.0. metric large does not give reliable metres from a single frame.

params.label: resolution
params.tooltip: Processing size (multiple of 14). 1008 is a good balance; higher = finer edges, slower.

params.label: normalization
params.tooltip: v2_style: near = white, like Depth Anything V2. min_max: stretched 0-1. raw: the model's own values (not reliable metres from one frame).

params.label: sky clip
params.tooltip: Detect the sky and push it to the far value.
